protocol.frozen: fit on 2019-01..(Y-1)-12, forecast Y (time-series models: 12-step forecast from December)
protocol.monthly: expanding refit (batch) or predict-then-learn (online) using rows before month t only
protocol.selection: every variant / hyperparameter / alpha / threshold / eta chosen on 2024 only; 2023 and 2025 are held out
protocol.note_2024: 2024 was also the selection year of RF logdiff (Protocol B); 2024 scores are optimistic.

order2_switch.note: The COVID-base branch (is_covid_lag12=1 -> level) is fixed by design; 2024 has no COVID-base rows, so 2024 cannot tune it.

order2_ewa.metric: 2024 monthly WAPE (online weights over monthly-refit experts)

notes: Order 3 optional extra (LightGBM init_model warm-start vs full refit) was not run: a full monthly refit takes well under a second at this data size, so warm-starting has no speed case to make; left for later.
